_comment: Install as /etc/starchart/principals.json (0640 root:starchart). Each principal's Token is a bearer secret — generate a long random value and keep it secret. Spaces are the scopes the principal may write to; ApproverSpaces are the scopes they may approve proposals in. A Restricted principal (e.g. a child account) is denied the RestrictedDenyTypes below as a HARD boundary. Comment keys (underscore-prefixed) are ignored by the loader.
